user.title: YellowGrid Romania Prices
user.description: Paste your YellowGrid `userToken` cookie and plant `deviceId`. See the install guide for how to copy them from your browser. The token renews itself automatically once set up.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate YellowGrid
reauth_confirm.description: Your YellowGrid session token has expired. Log in to yellowgrid.ro in your browser, copy a fresh `userToken` cookie, and paste it below. Device: {device_id}

error.missing_fields: Both the userToken cookie and the device ID are required.
error.invalid_token: Authentication failed. Copy the cookie from a fresh yellowgrid.ro login (Application → Cookies → userToken).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach YellowGrid. Check your network and try again.
